title: Hypha metamodel graph
description: The whole KerML or SysML v2 abstract-syntax metamodel of one release as a graph: packages, metaclasses with their precomputed inheritance closures, owned and inherited attributes, operations and constraints, plus enumerations and primitive types. Generated from the OMG XMI by tools/metamodel-gen, alongside the flat name lookup in index.json.

metamodel.description: The name of the model's root package, e.g. "KerML" or "SysML".

modelVersionUri.description: The URI of the model's root package, empty when it has none.

sourceXmiSha256.description: The provenance digest of the input XMI: the per-file digests, combined in filename order.

packages.description: Every named package, ordered by qualified name.

primitiveTypes.description: Every primitive type, ordered by name.

interfaces.description: Present only for a model that declares interfaces, which neither KerML nor SysML v2 does.

dataTypes.description: Data types that are neither primitive nor an enumeration. Present only for a model that declares them.

parent.description: The name of the owning namespace, null for a root package.

classes.description: The names of the metaclasses the package directly contains, ordered.

visibility.description: The visibility as its lowercase name, e.g. "public".

summary.description: The one-line summary of the documentation, may be empty.

extends.description: The names of the direct supertypes, ordered.

allAncestors.description: The names of every transitive supertype, ordered: the closure, so a reader never walks the generalization chain itself.

inheritedAttributes.description: The features inherited from supertypes, each tagged with the metaclass that declares it and with the feature that redefines it in this metaclass's context, if any. A feature whose name an owned attribute reuses is left out.

inheritedOperations.description: A reference to every operation the supertypes declare, ordered by name and then declaring metaclass; the signature and body are in that metaclass's ownedOperations.

inheritedConstraints.description: A reference to every constraint the supertypes declare, ordered by name and then declaring metaclass; the body is in that metaclass's constraints.

xmiId.description: The XMI id, empty when it has none. It normally stays the same across releases, so a renamed member is still matched; where upstream regenerated the ids, members are matched on their names.

type.description: The name of the attribute's type, null when it is untyped.

typeIsElement.description: Whether the type has an element of its own in this document.

upper.description: The upper multiplicity bound, -1 when unbounded.

isDerivedUnion.description: Whether the attribute is a derived union of the attributes that subset it.

defaultValue.description: The default value as the model writes it (a literal, or an enumeration literal's name), null when it has none.

redefines.description: The attributes it redefines, each with its owner.

subsets.description: The attributes it subsets, each with its owner.

opposite.description: The other end of the binary association the attribute is an end of; null when it is not one, or when the other end cannot be named because it, or the association that owns it, has no name (as in the Systems Modeling API PIM).

inheritedFrom.description: The name of the supertype that declares the attribute.

redefinedBy.description: The attribute that redefines this one in the inheriting metaclass's context, owned by it or by one of its supertypes; null when none does, so the attribute applies as inherited.

featureReference.description: An attribute by its owner: a classifier for an owned attribute, an association for an end the association owns. Exactly one of class and association is set.

operationReference.description: An operation by the classifier that owns it.

elementReference.description: A model element by its UML metaclass, owner and name.

kind.description: The element's UML metaclass, camel-cased: class, property, operation, and so on.

owner.description: The classifier or association that owns the element, null for an element owned by a package.

xmiId.description: The XMI id, empty when it has none. It normally stays the same across releases, so a renamed member is still matched; where upstream regenerated the ids, members are matched on their names.

returnType.description: The name of the return type, null when there is none or it is untyped.

returnUpper.description: The upper bound of the return multiplicity, -1 when unbounded.

parameters.description: The non-return parameters, in declaration order.

redefines.description: The operations it redefines, each with its owner.

body.description: The OCL of the operation's bodyCondition, may be empty.

class.description: The supertype that declares the operation.

operation.description: The operation name, unique among the operations its metaclass owns.

redefinedBy.description: The operation that redefines this one in the inheriting metaclass's context, owned by it or by one of its supertypes; null when none does, so this one applies.

xmiId.description: The XMI id, empty when it has none. It normally stays the same across releases, so a renamed member is still matched; where upstream regenerated the ids, members are matched on their names.

direction.description: The direction as its lowercase name, e.g. "in".

xmiId.description: The XMI id, empty when it has none. It normally stays the same across releases, so a renamed member is still matched; where upstream regenerated the ids, members are matched on their names.

ocl.description: The constraint body, may be empty.

constrainedElements.description: The elements the constraint constrains, in model order.

class.description: The supertype that declares the constraint.

constraint.description: The constraint name, unique among the constraints its metaclass owns.

interface.description: An interface and the classifiers that realize it. Present only for a model that declares interfaces, such as the Systems Modeling API PIM.

realizedBy.description: The names of the classifiers that realize the interface, ordered.

xmiId.description: The XMI id, empty when it has none. It normally stays the same across releases, so a renamed member is still matched; where upstream regenerated the ids, members are matched on their names.

type.description: A primitive type or a plain data type: a named element with no features of its own.
